name: Adaptability
description: Adaptability influences the height and shape of the risk curve reflecting the relative ease with which the organization can change and move along the curve.
stated_in: Appendix D, Using Risk Profiles when Prioritizing Risks

name: Complexity
description: Complexity of a risk will typically shift the risk curve upwards to reflect greater risk.
stated_in: Appendix D, Using Risk Profiles when Prioritizing Risks

name: Velocity
description: Velocity may affect the distance at which acceptable variation in performance is set from the target. (Note that the velocity of the risk also reflects the third dimension of time, and therefore is not reflected in the risk curve.)
stated_in: Appendix D, Using Risk Profiles when Prioritizing Risks

name: Persistence
description: Persistence, not shown on the risk curve as it relates to a third dimension, may be reflected in a narrowing of the acceptable variation in performance as the entity acknowledges the sustained effect on performance.
stated_in: Appendix D, Using Risk Profiles when Prioritizing Risks

name: Recovery
description: Recovery, the time taken to return to acceptable variation in performance, is considered part of persistence. How the entity recovers will shape the risk curve outside of the acceptable variation in performance and the relative ease with which the entity can move along the curve.
stated_in: Appendix D, Using Risk Profiles when Prioritizing Risks
